correctness.rationale: Independently recomposed E=R1R2s x exp(-a1s x-a2sR1x exp(-a1s x)) and L=R1R2s x exp(-a1x-a2sR1x exp(-a1x)). Thus log(E/L)=z[(1-s)-s rho (exp(-s z)-exp(-z))]. h(z) has derivative exp(-z)-s exp(-s z), a unique maximum at -log(s)/(1-s), with hmax=(1-s)s^{s/(1-s)}. This gives rho_c and the 0/1/2 root count exactly, regardless of nonmonotonicity of F2. The Taylor ratio h(zm+w)/h(zm)=1-(s/2)w²+O(w³) gives both x±=xm±sqrt(2epsilon/s)/a1+O(epsilon/a1). Tested exact rational witness signs for s=1/2,rho=5, and independent symbolic/numeric expansion. Domain s in (0,1), R_i,a_i,x>0; no n-season or yield extrapolation.
residual_risks: The two-stage algebra and derivative test are short classical calculus, but the exact sharp ecological intervention ordering and threshold are distinguished from textbook single-map facts.
